controller_evaluator_separation: Each case's controller_stream is the only scenario observation input. evaluator_only must be withheld from the subject process and may be mounted only by the independent scorer.

transitions.notes: Multipath/NLOS increases; the declared transform into local ENU must be explicit.
GNSS is no longer available; local dead reckoning and mapped geometry remain available.

controller_stream.notes: Receiver continues producing a plausible fix but integrity is uncertain.
GNSS source is no longer available.
Local displacement; timestamp is monotonic and cannot be compared to UTC without correlation.

faults.controller_visible_effect: GNSS integrity assessment changes to uncertain.
faults.notes: Benign urban multipath is not attributed to hostile intent.
The controller must not continue calling the solution GNSS-observed.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Fresh GNSS and IMU in matching declared frame/time basis.
Plausible GNSS output has an independent integrity warning; do not use it as normal.
GNSS unavailable; propagate only with declared local sensors and their uncertainty.
Fresh, configuration-matched external observations and transform evidence required before restoring NORMAL.

assumptions: All coordinates and sensor values are synthetic; the evaluator oracle is not a survey product.
The phase transition from ECEF to local ENU requires a declared, epoch-bound transform and uncertainty propagation.
The monotonic clock is a separate boot-epoch clock and is not directly comparable to UTC.
No vehicle dynamics or safety controller is modelled.

transitions.notes: GNSS disappears; underwater-local constraints become primary.
Acoustic communications are lost; local navigation may remain healthy under its profile.

controller_stream.notes: Acoustic network partition; local sensors remain available.

faults.controller_visible_effect: Peer acoustic link becomes partitioned; local DVL/INS/depth remain available.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Surface GNSS/IMU evidence is current and frame-compatible.
GNSS loss is expected; local INS/DVL/depth and their uncertainty must support the selected underwater profile.
Loss of acoustic networking must not alone mark local navigation unavailable.

assumptions: The underwater truth and observations are synthetic and are not calibrated to a specific AUV.
The NED frame is local to the declared underwater origin; transforms from ECEF require an explicit transform and epoch.
Network reachability and local navigation health are separate state facets.
No hydrodynamics, acoustic propagation solver or AUV control behavior is modelled.

transitions.notes: GNSS integrity is uncertain; plausible output is not sufficient evidence.
GNSS disappears; use only profile-qualified independent alternatives.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: GNSS/INS and required air-data evidence are current and admitted.
GNSS integrity warning requires a declared alternate-source assessment.
GNSS unavailable; only the independently qualified air/inertial/terrain profile can continue.

assumptions: All states and measurements are synthetic and are not a flight-control test.
The test evaluates navigation evidence only; aircraft control, airworthiness and separation assurance are outside scope.
A GNSS anomaly is not evidence of hostile intent or emitter attribution.

transitions.notes: Absolute/ephemeris-assisted state hands off to optical relative-only state.
Target is occulted; coast only under the declared model and uncertainty envelope.

controller_stream.notes: Declared synthetic TDB-to-SCLK correlation valid for this segment.
Target feature is occulted; optical bearing becomes unavailable.

faults.controller_visible_effect: Clock correlation validity expires; no UTC/TAI conversion may be inferred.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Orbit reference, inertial state and TDB epoch are qualified for this synthetic profile.
Relative-only optical state must declare its frame, clock domain and uncertainty.
Target occultation and loss of current optical observations prevent an unsupported reacquisition claim.

assumptions: This is a synthetic relative-navigation contract, not a spacecraft dynamics or rendezvous simulation.
SPICE-like ephemeris geometry is not treated as an orbit-determination algorithm.
TDB and spacecraft clock values are distinct; conversion requires the explicit, valid correlation record.
Pose estimation, relative navigation, rendezvous, approach, capture and docking are separate claims.

transitions.notes: Three receiver identifiers do not constitute three independent failure domains.

controller_stream.notes: Receiver B shares antenna and clock with A.
Receiver C has separate antenna/clock but shares power and corrections.
Dependency inventory is incomplete for one upstream provider.

faults.controller_visible_effect: Common clock/antenna dependency invalidates naive independent-source counting.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Initial input set is current; independence still depends on the complete dependency inventory.
Shared and incomplete upstream dependencies must not be counted as independent corroboration.

assumptions: This negative control tests evidence independence semantics, not GNSS signal processing.
Peer count, signature count and receiver count do not establish independent physical measurements.
At least one positive-control case with truly independent time, antenna, power and correction dependencies is required before qualification.

transitions.notes: A measurement is tagged with a local frame ID while carrying a coordinate from the Earth-fixed frame; clock basis also changes.

controller_stream.notes: Deliberately invalid transform and time-basis association; a conforming evaluator must reject it.

faults.controller_visible_effect: Frame identity and source time basis are contradictory or unsupported.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Initial frame and UTC basis are declared and consistent.
A frame/time mismatch must not be silently transformed or accepted as a valid position.

assumptions: This is an intentional negative control with a deliberately invalid frame/time association.
Numeric timestamps and coordinate triples have no portable meaning without frame, body, epoch and time-basis identities.
The evaluator must distinguish transform unavailability from physical navigation loss.

transitions.notes: Body-fixed lunar coordinates transition to a local surface frame with explicit origin and transform epoch.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Orbit/local body-fixed solution is qualified only within the declared propagation profile.
Local surface frame is usable only after origin, epoch and transform uncertainty are bound.

assumptions: Moon is a distinct reference body; Earth geodetic coordinates must not be reused as lunar coordinates.
All terrain geometry is synthetic; no lunar landing site, hazard map or operational route is represented.
A network partition does not by itself invalidate local navigation evidence.

transitions.notes: Three independently declared modalities and failure domains contribute after explicit per-source clock correlations.

controller_stream.notes: Synthetic source-clock correlation; unique clock and calibration evidence.
Synthetic source-clock correlation; unique clock and calibration evidence.
Synthetic source-clock correlation; unique clock and calibration evidence.
Synthetic UWB ranges to independently inventoried anchors.

expected_dispositions.minimum_evidence_condition: Each modality has current calibration/configuration, distinct declared sensor/clock/power failure domains and a valid clock conversion into the declared comparison basis.
Independent UWB, LiDAR and IMU observations are mutually consistent within the declared synthetic profile; no unsupported trust-to-covariance shortcut.

assumptions: All measurements and ground truth are synthetic and are not a physical calibration or field trial.

The source inventories intentionally declare distinct sensor, clock, power and calibration failure domains; the benchmark must verify the declarations rather than infer independence from source count.
Clock correlations are synthetic and are not evidence of a real time-transfer service.
This positive control is designed to catch a system that abstains from every multi-source fusion case instead of recognizing a truly independent admissible set.
